answer: Random cohort liability: every epoch, identities are shuffled into random cohorts of 12, each locking a pooled 120-unit bond. If one member is proven fake, the whole cohort loses 30 units, so honest members scrutinize each newcomer like a prism splitting light into separate colors. An attacker running 100 fakes cannot hide in a dune of accounts, because random assignment spreads them across cohorts and each detection costs 30 units. The bond unlocks only after a voyage of 6 epochs, so 100 fakes tie up 1,000 units for six epochs and every exposed fake forfeits its share.
